title: The Jungle Book. Mowgli and Baloo.
lines: Deep in the warm jungle of India, where the trees are tall and the vines hang down, lots of animals live.
Elephants, monkeys, snakes, bears, tigers and panthers.
One day the black panther Bagheera found something in a basket by the river.
Bagheera took him to a family of wolves.
The wolves raised the little boy as their own child.
Mowgli grew up in the jungle.
He could climb like a monkey, swim like a fish, and run with the wolves.
He didn't even know he was a human child.
A big cat, strong and fast.
But one day there was bad news.
The wicked tiger Shere Khan was back in the jungle.
Shere Khan was big and orange with black stripes, and he didn't like humans.
Mowgli must go, said the wolves.
He must go to the human village, where he'll be safe.
So Bagheera took Mowgli with him.
But Mowgli didn't want to go.
I want to stay in the jungle!
I don't want to go to the village!
At night they slept in a tree.
But along came a long snake.
He had big round eyes that spun.
But Bagheera gave Kaa a whack.
The next day Mowgli walked off on his own.
But then he heard someone singing and humming.
A big, fat, grey bear came waddling along.
He was big and soft and very lazy.
He loved eating, dancing and lazing around.
He scratched his back against a tree.
And I don't want to go to the village.
I'll teach you everything about the jungle!
And Baloo taught Mowgli the very best things.
He taught him to dance and sing.
He taught him to growl like a bear.
Baloo also taught him to relax.
You shouldn't worry so much, said Baloo.
Together they floated on the river.
Baloo lay on his back, and Mowgli lay on his tummy.
Splash, they drifted gently along with the current.
Baloo peeled one and popped it in his mouth.
They grabbed Mowgli and swung him through the trees to their king, the big ape King Louie.
King Louie wanted to learn how humans make fire.
Baloo and Bagheera came to rescue Mowgli.
Baloo dressed up as a monkey, with coconuts for ears.
And they danced until the whole monkey palace fell down.
Then Bagheera said to Baloo: Mowgli really must go to the village.
Shere Khan is looking for him.
Baloo was sad, but he knew Bagheera was right.
He held the tiger by his tail.
Mowgli took a burning branch and tied it to Shere Khan's tail.
The tiger got such a fright that he ran away and never came back.
Then they walked together to the edge of the human village.
Mowgli heard a girl singing by the river.
She was carrying a jug of water.
He followed her into the village.
He looked back one last time.
And then Baloo and Bagheera danced back into the jungle together.
